memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'When I see the blood, I will pass over you.'

sequence.prompt: How did God keep His people safe that night? Put it in order.

items.label: Each family took a perfect lamb
They ate the meal together inside
In the morning they walked out free

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It died in the family's place

application.question: They were safe because of the lamb, not because they were good. Where do you go when you need to feel safe?
application.followUp: Nobody inside those houses was safe because they were braver or better. They were safe because of the lamb. We are safe because of Jesus.
